title: Zamil Shop BD — Baby & Kids Shop
tagline: A bilingual baby & kids store, fully working in your browser
description: The customer side of Zamil Shop BD, a baby and kids shop from Dhaka: shop by age (0–6 months to 5 years), a gift finder, a gift registry for new parents, ride-on toys with real product photos, Bangla/English switch, cart and Cash on Delivery checkout with bKash, Nagad and Rocket. This is the shop's real code running in the browser — orders you place here appear in the Zamil Shop BD admin demo.
highlights: Shop by age, gift finder and a gift registry parents can share
Safety badges show only with a certificate attached
Checkout fills Division → District → Upazila with a live delivery fee by zone
Phone check at checkout: the SMS code appears on screen in the demo
Every confirmed order gets an invoice number and a PDF invoice
Coupon WELCOME100 works on a first order over ৳1,500
Orders you place show up in the admin demo — it is one working system
Optional shopper sign-in: 01700000001 / demo12345 — nothing is charged or delivered, and ?demo-reset starts fresh
